function MainBoardView:_OnSpreadFailed(message)
  local key
  if message.Reason == SpreadFailedReason.ItemClosed then
    key = "hint_item_locked"
  elseif message.Reason == SpreadFailedReason.ItemOpening then
    key = "hint_item_opening"
  elseif message.Reason == SpreadFailedReason.ItemRecharging then
    key = "hint_item_recharging"
    GM.AudioModel:PlayEffect(AudioFileConfigName.SfxColdingClick)
    local itemSpread = message.Item:GetComponent(ItemSpread)
    if itemSpread ~= nil then
      local restDuration = itemSpread:GetTimerDuration() + itemSpread:GetStartTimer() - GM.GameModel:GetServerTime()
      if 1200 <= restDuration then
        UIHelper.TryOpenWXSubscriptionWindow(SubscriptionType.CDRecover, true)
      end
    end
  else
    key = "hint_board_full"
  end
  local itemView = self:GetItemView(message.Item)
  local targetPosition = (itemView and itemView.transform.position or V3Zero) + Vector3(0, 100, 0)
  local screenPosition = self:ConvertWorldPositionToScreenPosition(targetPosition)
  GM.UIManager:ShowPromptWithKey(key, screenPosition)
  if message.Reason == SpreadFailedReason.ItemRecharging or message.Reason == SpreadFailedReason.ItemOpening then
    self.m_infoBar:GetInfoContent():PlaySkipButtonEffect()
  elseif message.Reason == SpreadFailedReason.ItemClosed and not self.m_model:HasOpeningItem() then
    self.m_infoBar:GetInfoContent():PlayOpenButtonEffect()
  end
end

function BundleEnergyModel:Try2TriggerEnergyBundle()
  if self:_CanTriggerEnergyBundle() then
    if self:_GetCurState() == EBundleEnergyState.None then
      self.m_metaDBTable:Set(EBundleMetaKey.EnergyGroupId, BundleMetaDBColumnValue, self.m_dataGroup:GetGroupId())
      self.m_metaDBTable:Set(EBundleMetaKey.EnergyGroupState, BundleMetaDBColumnValue, EBundleEnergyState.Open)
      self.m_metaDBTable:Set(EBundleMetaKey.EnergyNextStateTime, BundleMetaDBColumnValue, GM.GameModel:GetServerTime() + self.m_dataGroup:GetGroupLastDuration())
    end
    local curBundle = self:_GetNextTriggerBundleData()
    if curBundle == nil then
      curBundle = self.m_dataGroup:GetConfigData(self.m_dataGroup:GetBundleIds()[1])
    end
    self.m_manager:ClearBundleDatas(EBundleType.EnergyBundle)
    local curTime = GM.GameModel:GetServerTime()
    self.m_dbTable:BatchSet({
      [curBundle:GetBundleId()] = {
        [EBundleDBKey.DBColumnLeftCount] = 1,
        [EBundleDBKey.DBColumnRefreshTime] = INVALID_TIME,
        [EBundleDBKey.DBColumnLastTime] = GM.GameModel:GetServerTime() + self.m_dataGroup:GetBundleLastDuration(),
        [EBundleDBKey.DBColumnBundleType] = EBundleType.EnergyBundle,
        [EBundleDBKey.DBColumnPurchaseId] = curBundle:GetPurchaseId(),
        [EBundleDBKey.DBColumnGroupId] = self.m_dataGroup:GetGroupId()
      }
    })
    self.m_metaDBTable:Set(EBundleMetaKey.EnergyTriggerCount, BundleMetaDBColumnValue, self:_GetTriggerCount() + 1)
    EventDispatcher.DispatchEvent(EEventType.BundleDataRefreshed)
  end
end

function BundleEnergyModel:_GetNextTriggerBundleData()
  local curBundleIndex
  local bundleIds = self.m_dataGroup:GetBundleIds()
  for index, bundleId in ipairs(bundleIds) do
    if self.m_dbTable:HasRow(bundleId) then
      if self.m_dbTable:GetValue(bundleId, EBundleDBKey.DBColumnLeftCount, 0) == 0 then
        curBundleIndex = index % #bundleIds + 1
      else
        curBundleIndex = index
      end
    end
  end
  return curBundleIndex ~= nil and self.m_dataGroup:GetConfigData(bundleIds[curBundleIndex]) or nil
end

function BundleEnergyModel:_CanTriggerEnergyBundle()
  if not self.m_bLateInited then
    return false
  end
  self:_Try2UpdateTriggerCount()
  if self.m_dataGroup == nil or self:_GetTriggerCount() >= self.m_dataGroup:GetTriggerMaxNum() then
    return false
  end
  if self:_GetCurState() == EBundleEnergyState.CoolingDown then
    return false
  end
  if GM.ShopModel:IsEnergyFreeRefill(EnergyType.Main) then
    return false
  end
  if GM.ShopModel:GetBuyEnergyGemCost(EnergyType.Main, true) < self.m_dataGroup:GetTriggerPrice() then
    return false
  end
  local bundleIds = self.m_dataGroup:GetBundleIds()
  for i, bundleId in ipairs(bundleIds) do
    if self.m_manager:IsBundleDataValid(bundleId) then
      return false
    end
  end
  if GM.EnergyModel:GetEnergy(EnergyType.Main) >= ItemSpread.GetCostEnergyNum() then
    return false
  end
  if GM.ShopModel:IsChainEnergyOpen() then
    return false
  end
  return true
end

  if Table.IsEmpty(self.m_chainEnergyConfig) then

  end

  if endTime <= GM.GameModel:GetServerTime() then
